scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 59 km this is Route des Grandes Alpes, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-baie-de-chatillon-the-architectur.story: From Châtillon it runs 366 km to Châtillon; allow about 6 h 19 of riding. The stops in between: Les Marais de Saint-Jorioz, Immeuble Clarté, Stations de Morges and The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
